item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.12)] IonQ vs. Quantum Computing Inc.: Which Quantum Computing Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.12)
This article compares IonQ (IONQ) and Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) to determine which quantum computing stock is a better investment in 2026. While both companies operate in a nascent, high-risk, high-reward industry, IonQ, with its trapped-ion technology and strong cloud partnerships, is favored due to its explosive revenue growth, significant commercial traction, and more attractive price-to-sales ratio. QCi, focusing on photonic chips and government contracts, shows potential but operates at a much smaller scale with lower revenue.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.23)] What Goldman Sachs Group (GS)'s NVIDIA AI Financing Role and New Bond Issuance Means For Shareholders
item.description:

This strategy, combined with strong Q2 2026 earnings, positions Goldman to participate in AI growth while returning capital to shareholders. However, investors should be mindful of potential regulatory changes and ongoing fee compression that could impact the bank's capital return profile.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.10)] GTA 6 Cyberleek update: Everything leaked so far, what might be next
item.description:

It lists several clips and screenshots purportedly showing parts of the game, such as map sneak peeks, gameplay footage featuring protagonist Jason Duval, and in-game mechanics. item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.30)] ExxonMobil vs. Chevron: We Compared 10 Years of Dividend Growth And Here's the Winner
item.description:

The author leans towards ExxonMobil for dividend durability but finds Chevron more interesting for current income and optionality.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.46)] Nvidia's dedicated inference accelerator Groq 3 LPX enters full production to supercharge AI agents
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.46)
Nvidia's Groq 3 LPX, a dedicated AI inference accelerator, has entered full production to enhance AI agent performance. The chip, part of Nvidia's Vera Rubin data center platform, is designed for ultra-fast token generation to prevent decode latency in complex AI workloads. Nebius Group N.V. is the first customer to adopt the Groq 3 LPX, which leverages technology acquired from Groq Inc. and has demonstrated record-breaking token output in benchmark tests.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.02)] Microsoft, PowerHouse Hillwood in disputes over data center service agreements
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.02)
Microsoft and PowerHouse Hillwood are embroiled in separate disputes with utility companies over service agreements for their planned data centers in Wisconsin and Illinois, respectively. Microsoft claims agreements with American Transmission Co. and Wisconsin Electric Power Co. fail to protect ratepayers from infrastructure costs, while PowerHouse Hillwood is challenging Commonwealth Edison's cancellation of a transmission security agreement for its Illinois data center, alleging anti-competitive behavior. Both companies have petitioned FERC to intervene, highlighting broader concerns about utility transparency and cost allocation for large load interconnections.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.32)] Walmart’s OnePay Expands Apple Pay Wallet Support
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.32)
OnePay, Walmart's financial-services company, is adding Apple Pay support for its credit cards, enabling cardholders to use their cards wherever Apple Pay is accepted. This expansion coincides with Walmart beginning to accept contactless payments in its U.S. stores, a significant shift for the retailer which had previously resisted contactless technology. While OnePay's debit card already supported Apple Pay, this move will extend the functionality to its CashRewards and Builder credit cards, issued by Synchrony Bank.

The article also highlights other companies like Dell, Hewlett Packard, and NVIDIA with favorable earnings potential.

item.title: [NVDA Bearish (-0.22)] Taiwan Indicts Nvidia Manager Following Chip Smuggling Probe
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bearish (-0.22)
Taiwanese prosecutors have indicted a senior Nvidia manager, surnamed Chang, and eight others for allegedly smuggling advanced AI chips into China. The group is accused of organizing the shipment of 74 servers containing high-end B300 chips through Japan and Indonesia, thereby circumventing US trade restrictions. This marks Taiwan's first known crackdown on the black-market trade of such AI accelerators.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.32)] ePlus Acquires Daymark Solutions Assets, Expanding Microsoft and New England Capabilities
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.32)
ePlus Inc. (NASDAQ: PLUS) has acquired the assets of Daymark Solutions, a Massachusetts-based IT solutions provider, to expand its Microsoft capabilities and strengthen its presence in the New England technology market. The acquisition brings expertise in hybrid cloud, cybersecurity, and modern data centers, particularly within highly regulated industries, and complements ePlus's existing Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 services. This move aligns with ePlus's services-led strategy and enhances its geographic reach in the metropolitan Boston area.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.14)] Walmart Has Too Many Stores
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.14)
Walmart's U.S. comparable store sales grew only 2.6% last quarter, the slowest in six years, contrasting with peers like Target which saw 3.6% growth. Despite a 24% surge in e-commerce, Walmart maintains a physical footprint of 4,615 U.S. stores, a number that has barely changed in a decade, even as Amazon's revenue tripled. The article suggests that Walmart's extensive store count, which ensures 90% of Americans are within 10 miles of a store, might be a costly overlap in a retail landscape increasingly dominated by e-commerce.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.42)] Perplexity Deal Highlights a Pattern in Nvidia's AI Investments
item.description:

Nvidia's reported talks to invest in AI startup Perplexity, valuing it at over $30 billion, exemplify a growing pattern in Nvidia's investment strategy. The chipmaker consistently invests in AI companies that build their businesses on Nvidia's infrastructure, creating a reinforcing cycle where Nvidia benefits from both hardware sales and equity in growing AI firms. This approach extends beyond public holdings to private investments in various AI startups across the value chain.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.33)] Microsoft Teams now lets admins block external bots from meetings
item.description:

This new feature builds on a previous policy introduced in June that required organizer approval for detected bots. The updated policy provides additional control over meeting security by preventing third-party and potentially malicious bots from accessing Teams meetings without explicit confirmation.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.15)] Seagate stock trades softer as tech sector slides ahead of key Nvidia earnings

item.description:

item.description:
